rationale: Monotonic Volt-VAR curve designed to mitigate voltage violations at t_low (0.94 pu) and t_high (1.07 pu) while minimizing reactive power effort. At 0.94 pu, injects 18% of available Q (14.4 kVAR) to raise voltage to 0.95008 pu. At 1.07 pu, absorbs 36% of available Q (-28.8 kVAR) to lower voltage to 1.04984 pu. Zero reactive power commanded in nominal voltage range.
